H575: where?; hence, whither?, when?; also hither and thither
H1980: to walk (in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively)
H1730: (figuratively) to love; by implication, a love-token, lover, friend; specifically an uncle
H6437: to turn; by implication, to face, i.e. appear, look, etc.
H1245: to search out (by any method, specifically in worship or prayer); by implication, to strive after
H5973: adverb or preposition, with (i.e. in conjunction with), in varied applications; specifically, equally with; often with prepositional prefix (and then usually unrepresented in English)
H3381: to descend (literally, to go downwards; or conventionally to a lower region, as the shore, a boundary, the enemy, etc.; or figuratively, to fall); causatively, to bring down (in all the above applications)
H6170: something piled up (as if (figuratively) raised by mental aspiration), i.e. a paterre
H1314: fragrance; by implication, spicery; also the balsam plant
H7462: to tend a flock; i.e. pasture it; intransitively, to graze (literally or figuratively); generally to rule; by extension, to associate with (as a friend)
H3950: properly, to pick up, i.e. (generally) to gather; specifically, to glean
H7799: a lily (from its whiteness), as aflower of architectural ornament; also a (straight) trumpet (from the tubular shape)
H859: thou and thee, or (plural) ye and you
H8656: Tirtsah, a place in Palestine; also an Israelitess
H3389: Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine
H1713: to flaunt, i.e. raise a flag; figuratively, to be conspicuous
H5437: to revolve, surround, or border; used in various applications, literally and figuratively
H5869: an eye (literally or figuratively); by analogy, a fountain (as the eye of the landscape)
H5048: a front, i.e. part opposite; specifically a counterpart, or mate; usually (adverbial, especially with preposition) over against or before
H7292: to urge severely, i.e. (figuratively) importune, embolden, capture, act insolently
H5795: a she-goat (as strong), but masculine in plural (which also is used elliptically for goat's hair)
H4480: properly, a part of; hence (prepositionally), from or out of in many senses
H1568: Gilad, a region East of the Jordan; also the name of three Israelites
H8127: a tooth (as sharp); specifically ivory; figuratively, a cliff
H7353: a ewe (the females being the predominant element of a flock) (as a good traveller)
H5927: to ascend, intransitively (be high) or actively (mount); used in a great variety of senses, primary and secondary, literal and figurative
H3605: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
H8382: to be (causatively, make) twinned, i.e. (figuratively) duplicate or (architectural) jointed
H369: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
H7416: a pomegranate, the tree (from its upright growth) or the fruit (also an artificial ornament)
H7541: properly, thinness, i.e. the side of the head
H1157: in up to or over against; generally at, beside, among, behind, for, etc.
H4557: a number, definite (arithmetical) or indefinite (large, innumerable; small, a few); also (abstractly) narration
H259: properly, united, i.e. one; or (as an ordinal) first
H1931: he (she or it); only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also (intensively) self, or (especially with the article) the same; sometimes (as demonstrative) this or that; occasionally (instead of copula) as or are
H3123: a dove (apparently from the warmth of their mating)
H8535: complete; usually (morally) pious; specifically, gentle, dear
H517: a mother (as the bond of the family); in a wide sense (both literally and figuratively (like father))
H3205: to bear young; causatively, to beget; medically, to act as midwife; specifically, to show lineage
H7200: to see, literally or figuratively (in numerous applications, direct and implied, transitive, intransitive and causative)
H1323: a daughter (used in the same wide sense as other terms of relationship, literally and figuratively)
H833: to be straight (used in the widest sense, especially to be level, right, happy); figuratively, to go forward, be honest, proper
H1984: to be clear (orig. of sound, but usually of color); to shine; hence, to make ashow, to boast; and thus to be (clamorously) foolish; to rave; causatively, to celebrate; also to stultify
H4310: who? (occasionally, by a peculiar idiom, of things); also (indefinitely) whoever; often used in oblique construction with prefix or suffix
H8259: properly, to lean out (of a window), i.e. (by implication) peep or gaze (passively, be a spectacle)
H3644: a form of the prefix 'k-', but used separately as, thus, so
H413: near, with or among; often in general, to
H5158: a stream, especially a winter torrent; (by implication) a (narrow) valley (in which a brook runs); also a shaft (of a mine)
H6524: to break forth as a bud, i.e. bloom; generally, to spread; specifically, to fly (as extending the wings); figuratively, to flourish
H1612: a vine (as twining), especially the grape
H5132: properly, to flash; hence, to blossom (from the brilliancy of color); also, to fly away (from the quickness of motion)
H3808: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
H3045: to know (properly, to ascertain by seeing); used in a great variety of senses, figuratively, literally, euphemistically and inferentially (including observation, care, recognition; and causatively, instruction, designation, punishment, etc.)
H5315: properly, a breathing creature, i.e. animal of (abstractly) vitality; used very widely in a literal, accommodated or figurative sense (bodily or mental)
H7760: to put (used in a great variety of applications, literal, figurative, inferentially, and elliptically)
H5971: a people (as a congregated unit); specifically, a tribe (as those of Israel); hence (collectively) troops or attendants; figuratively, a flock
H5081: properly, voluntary, i.e. generous; hence, magnanimous; as noun, a grandee (sometimes a tyrant)
H7725: to turn back (hence, away) transitively or intransitively, literally or figuratively (not necessarily with the idea of return to the starting point); generally to retreat; often adverbial, again
H7759: peaceful (with the article always prefixed, making it a pet name); the Shulammith, an epithet of Solomon's queen
H2372: to gaze at; mentally to perceive, contemplate (with pleasure); specifically, to have avision of
H4100: properly, interrogative what? (including how? why? when?); but also exclamation, what! (including how!), or indefinitely what (including whatever, and even relatively, that which); often used with prefixes in various adverbial or conjunctive senses
H4264: an encampment (of travellers or troops); hence, an army, whether literal (of soldiers) or figurative (of dancers, angels, cattle, locusts, stars; or even the sacred courts)
